title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: size of a dispute credit and the decision recorded
content:
## Scope

Under the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, this rule sets the credit due on a demurrage invoice line disputed on the rate-misapplied or free-time-misapplied ground, and the decision recorded on the dispute.

## Rule

1. The excess billed is the amount invoiced on the demurrage line less the recomputed amount, and there is none when the recomputed amount is not lower.
2. The credit is the smaller of that excess and the disputed amount of the dispute still submitted on the line, taken to the cent.
3. The dispute is recorded upheld when the credit equals the disputed amount, partially upheld when the credit is positive but smaller, and denied, with no credit entry, when nothing was billed in excess.
4. The credit may include the dangerous-goods uplift that the line billed on days or rates the recomputation removes, while the uplift carried by the recomputed amount is never credited.

## Decision table (hypothetical line of USD 900.00)

| Recomputed amount | Excess billed | Disputed amount | Credit | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| USD 700.00 | USD 200.00 | USD 150.00 | USD 150.00 | upheld |
| USD 700.00 | USD 200.00 | USD 200.00 | USD 200.00 | upheld |
| USD 700.00 | USD 200.00 | USD 250.00 | USD 200.00 | partially upheld |
| USD 950.00 | none | USD 250.00 | none | denied, no credit entry |
| USD 900.00 | none | USD 100.00 | none | denied, no credit entry |

## Points of judgement

**Q: The customer disputed more than the line was overbilled. What is credited?**
A: Only the excess billed; the dispute is recorded partially upheld.

**Q: The line carried a dangerous-goods uplift and the recomputation also carries one. Is the recomputed uplift credited?**
A: No. Only uplift billed on days or rates the recomputation removes may be part of the credit.
